notes.title: Demonheart: The Cursed Trial Update
notes.notes:
My latest project in the Demonheart world just got a major update!

Demonheart: The Cursed Trial Chapter 6 is out!

The Cursed Trial is a murder mystery / romance in which Raze ("The Seer") has captured a group of humans for the entertainment of his demonic master. (Raze doesn't really have a master, he just made a deal with someone and is playing along.)

The main character, whose name you can change, can fall in love with two of her fellow captives.

If you haven't joined in on the adventure yet, consider doing so now by wishlisting or purchasing The Cursed Trial - your interest and support mean a lot!

notes.title: Demonheart: Hunters - Anniversary content update!
notes.notes:
It's been almost 4 years since Demonheart: Hunters came out! I wanted to thank you all for your interest in my games and your support, so I was secretly preparing this content update. It came out a few days ago on Windows, and now it's available on Mac OS and Linux as well.

You can read the full list of changes in the announcement here.

In the meantime, I'll continue working on the fourth chapter of Demonheart: The Cursed Trial ːheart_eyes_yetiː

notes.title: Progress Update - End of November 2023
notes.notes:
Hello! I'm here with a progress update on Demonheart: The Cursed Trial, which came out in early access.

I'm happy with the reactions the game has received so far, as well as the love certain characters are getting. ːhappy_yetiː

There is now fanart of the Cursed Trial characters.  ːsurprised_yetiː Some of it is in the Artwork section in the Steam community, and more art has been posted on the Rolling Crown Discord or Tumblr, Twitter etc, if you search for it.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/f1cd77c8c327470d262484aa7a923ef4ce2cdd87.png

I have been working on the script for the next chapter. As of today, around 12.400 words are in-game for Chapter 4, with more in text documents, waiting to be edited and used. After I am done with the first version of the text, the game will still need testing, scene edits for the scenes that turn out to need it, and polish such as adding sound effects. There will be two new CGs, which are already finished. The estimate for the chapter's release is early February.

I have posted the planned timeline for releasing all the chapters on the store page and in the Steam discussions here - it could change over time, but that is the general plan. With the holiday season ahead, I expected late December and early January to be a slower time for work, so that's why Chapter 4 is planned to come out in February, even though it feels like it could be finished sooner. ːdazed_yetiː

notes.title: Cursed Trial - Demo Update
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/b7238acd9f3138009f0174eb5580a6a91ba2728b.jpg

While working on the third out of the seven chapters of Demonheart: The Cursed Trial, I went back to the first chapter (demo) and made some edits. There are a lot of small changes which you may or may not notice if you replay.

Changes:

 Rephrased many lines of narration and dialog.
 Changed some expressions and sprite positions. Changed Ran's expression on several occasions into less childish and more manly ones. ':)
 Added a few new choices and NPC lines - nothing crucial, but these changes will mess with old saves. Old alignment and relationship points will be preserved, but you may end up on the wrong line when you reload.
 Started silently tracking Janiya's approval. Old saves didn't track this, so it will be like your relationship with her was neutral. Which is not the worst it could be. ':)
 Changed some sound effects.


The demo is available here! Don't forget to wishlist the Cursed Trial!

Meanwhile, the third chapter is nearly finished, and when it's polished, there's a possibility of Steam early access! Stay tuned for news about it, and thank you for following!
